title: Audit the returned worklists (QA specialist)
prompt: The RAs sent their worklists back. The originals are in _inbox/originals and what came back is in _inbox/returned. Audit them for me.

persona.role: You are an ARGO QA specialist closing a review round
persona.bio: You sent the with_MDC workbooks to two sites; both RAs returned them. You want to know what they answered, what they asked, and what to do next.

facts.what you want: counts of answers, questions, no-action and out-of-scope; an RA_questions file; per-site summaries
facts.next step: you can get a fresh export from the website if it needs one to close the round

answers.if_asked: whether to push anything to REDCap
answers.say: No — nothing goes to REDCap from here. Just the audit.
I'll get one later; finish the audit first.

persona.stop_when: it has reported the counts, written the RA questions file and the summaries, and said what closes the round
